name: Household Upright Vacuum Cleaner
definition: A mains-powered household dry vacuum whose upright body, floor head, dust collection and primary controls form one floor-cleaning assembly.
includedScope: Bagged and bagless corded household uprights
Lift-away or hose-equipped uprights when used in their documented household configuration
excludedScope: Cordless sticks, canisters, handhelds and robots
Wet pickup, carpet washing and commercial upright procurement
primaryApplications: Household carpet and approved hard-floor dry pickup
Stairs, upholstery and above-floor cleaning with documented tools
headline: Household upright vacuum heads, bags, bins, filters and buyer checks
description: This profile separates floor-head geometry, brush control, height setting, air path, bag or bin, filtration, cord, hose and tools so buyers can compare household uprights without treating watts or marketing claims as complete pickup results.
metaDescription: Household upright vacuum guide covering bagged and bagless types, heads, filters, models, standards and buyer checks.
disclaimer: This independent category reference is not electrical, allergy, hazardous-dust or surface-care advice. Confirm the exact regional model, manual, floor approval, bag or bin, filter, belt, brush and tool before procurement or use.

keyFacts.label: Category boundary
keyFacts.value: Corded household dry vacuum with integrated upright body and floor head
keyFacts.evidence: Official product pages identify corded upright dry-vacuum architectures.

keyFacts.label: Buyer verification
keyFacts.value: Match floor approval, brush setting, belt, bag or bin and filters by exact model
keyFacts.evidence: Manufacturer pages and manuals publish model-specific configurations and service items.
keyFacts.scope: Exact market, model and serial family.

systemFlow.name: Surface interface
systemFlow.componentFamily: Floor head, soleplate, brush roll and height control
systemFlow.role: Presents airflow and optional agitation to the approved floor.
systemFlow.evidence: Official sources document different head and brush-control systems.

systemFlow.name: Air and dirt path
systemFlow.componentFamily: Motor, duct, separator or bag, filter and exhaust seals
systemFlow.role: Moves air, separates debris and controls exhaust within the declared design.
systemFlow.evidence: Bagged and bagless official sources show materially different collection paths.

variants.name: Bagless upright
variants.operatorRelationship: User pushes the complete machine and empties a reusable bin
variants.spaceConstraints: Body depth, steering radius, cord and hose storage
variants.limitations: Bin size and cyclonic labels do not establish pickup or filtration.
variants.evidence: Shark, BISSELL and Hoover publish bagless uprights.

variants.name: Bagged upright
variants.taskScale: Household carpet and above-floor dry pickup
variants.operatorRelationship: User replaces a model-specific disposable bag
variants.spaceConstraints: Bag stock, hose reach and storage
variants.limitations: HEPA-media bag wording is not automatically a whole-machine result.
variants.evidence: Hoover publishes UH30650PC as a bagged upright with HEPA-media bag.

performanceMetrics.name: Pickup performance
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: Ability to remove defined debris from a defined surface
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Debris, floor, direction, head, brush, filter state and method must match
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: Do not compare watts, amps or unqualified suction as a pickup result.
performanceMetrics.evidence: IEC and manufacturer claims identify test-specific methods.

performanceMetrics.name: Reach and capacity
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: Potential task area and time between emptying
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Cord, hose, wand, practical fill line and tool differ
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: Maximum reach and nominal bin volume do not establish usability.
performanceMetrics.evidence: Official pages publish model-specific cord, hose and capacity values.

applicationFit.application: Mixed carpet and approved hard floors
applicationFit.wcbAssessment: Witness matched pickup and steering trials on the actual floor transitions.
applicationFit.basis: Head geometry, brush control, height and debris interact.
applicationFit.limitations: A multi-floor label is not universal surface approval.
applicationFit.buyerAction: Record passes, scatter, push force, edge residue and visible surface change.
applicationFit.evidence: Official sources describe model-specific multi-surface operation and controls.

applicationFit.wcbAssessment: Trial the exact hose, wand and tools with intended users.
applicationFit.basis: Tip stability, hose pull, carried load and reach determine fit.
applicationFit.limitations: Catalogue reach does not establish safe ergonomics.
applicationFit.buyerAction: Check stability, tool retention, reach and cord routing.
applicationFit.evidence: Manufacturers publish model-specific hoses and onboard tools.

componentStack.name: Head and brush system
componentStack.role: Controls floor contact, agitation and inlet geometry.
componentStack.evidence: Official sources document distinct head architectures.

componentStack.name: Collection and filtration
componentStack.role: Stores debris and filters the declared air path.
componentStack.evidence: Official sources distinguish bagged and bagless service systems.

distinguishingSpecifications: Automatic dirt, edge, floor and direction responses
representativeModels.evidence: Shark publishes the named configuration and qualified test methods.
Hoover publishes the named bagged model.

distinguishingSpecifications: Model-specific hose, filters and brush roll
representativeModels.evidence: Eureka publishes the official NEU250-series manual.

procurementDecisions.attributeToVerify: Pickup, scatter, brush control and push force on actual surfaces
procurementDecisions.comparisonTrap: Ranking by motor input or marketing superlative
procurementDecisions.basis: Surface, head, debris and filter state interact.
procurementDecisions.limitations: No single catalogue value predicts the result.
procurementDecisions.buyerAction: Document method, passes, residue and surface change.
procurementDecisions.evidence: IEC and manufacturer pages show method- and model-specific claims.

procurementDecisions.attributeToVerify: Bags, filters, belts, brushes and tools
procurementDecisions.assessment: Attach exact part codes and supply terms to the quote.
procurementDecisions.basis: Service items are model and serial specific.
procurementDecisions.buyerAction: Obtain part numbers, prices, lead times and warranty terms.
procurementDecisions.evidence: Official manuals and product pages identify model-specific systems.

engineeringChecks.reason: Damaged mains components create safety risks.
engineeringChecks.buyerAction: Confirm regional rating, plug, cord inspection and service instructions.
engineeringChecks.evidence: IEC defines covered household vacuum safety scope.
engineeringChecks.scope: Regional adoption and exact product conformity.

engineeringChecks.check: Bag, bin, filter and seal identity
engineeringChecks.reason: Leaks or loading alter airflow and containment.
engineeringChecks.buyerAction: Match service codes and document cleaning or replacement intervals.
engineeringChecks.evidence: Official sources publish model-specific collection systems.

standards.name: IEC 62885-2:2021
standards.applicability: Performance measurement methods for covered household dry vacuum cleaners.
standards.scope: Use only with matched methods and conditions.

standards.name: IEC 60335-2-2:2026
standards.applicability: Safety requirements for covered household vacuum cleaners and motorized cleaning heads.

developments.summary: The edition updates performance measurement coverage for household dry vacuum cleaners.
developments.evidence: IEC records the date and scope.
